scripts.setup: npm run setup:server && npm run setup:client && npm run setup:desktop && npm run setup:mobile
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -c magentaBright,cyanBright,greenBright -n SERWER,WIDZET,OKNO "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -c magentaBright,cyanBright -n SERWER,WIDZET "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:render: concurrently -c cyanBright,greenBright -n WIDZET,OKNO "npm run dev --prefix client" "cross-env MIKU_SERVER_URL=wss://aplikacja-komunikator.onrender.com MIKU_AUTO_CONNECT=true npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.start:render: npm run setup && npm run dev:render
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:client && npm run sync --prefix mobile
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build:mobile && npm run open --prefix mobile
